name: vektor-extension
description: Browser extension prototype for turning viral X/Twitter posts into memecoin launch plans.

scripts.check: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/content.js && node --check src/dashboard.js && node --check src/page-wallet.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check server/index.js
scripts.lint:firefox: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md .gitignore web-ext-artifacts
scripts.zip:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && python3 scripts/zipdir.py dist/firefox web-ext-artifacts/vektor-firefox.zip
scripts.zip:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs chrome && python3 scripts/zipdir.py dist/chrome web-ext-artifacts/vektor-chrome.zip
scripts.build:zips: npm run zip:firefox && npm run zip:chrome
